canonical_title: Exterior field of view - Rotary-wing air vehicles with side-by-side pilots
subject_group: 9.4.4 External visibility and transmitted visual indications

versions.title_at_revision: Exterior field of view - Rotary-wing air vehicles with side-by-side pilots
versions.text:
Standard: The following are the minimum angles of unimpaired vision available to the pilots from the design eye position in TABLE XIV. TABLE XIV. Exterior FOV - Rotary-wing with side-by-side pilots. At 0° azimuth, 25° down and 20° up. From 10° left azimuth to 10° right azimuth, downward vision should increase from 20° to 30°. Between 10° right azimuth and 135° right azimuth, 50° of downward vision should be available. From 0° to 80° right azimuth, upward vision should increase from 20° to 40°. From 80° right azimuth to 100° right azimuth, upward vision should be 40°. From 100° right azimuth to 135° right azimuth, upward vision may decrease gradually from 40° to 20°. From 10° left azimuth to 100° left azimuth, 20° up and 20° down should be available. No vertical obstruction between 20 degrees right and 20 degrees left of the longitudinal axis relative to the design eye position. No horizontal obstructions in the area extending 15 degrees above the horizon from 135 degrees right to 40 degrees left and decreasing to a point 10 degrees above the horizon at 100 degrees left. Mounting structures for the transparency sections do not exceed 2.0 inches in width when projected onto a plane perpendicular to a line between the structure and the design eye position. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analyze vision plots and verify that the total envelope (plus and minus 180 degrees in azimuth and plus and minus 90 degrees in elevation) from each crewmember’s design eye box provides the required clear vision areas as described in the standard. Vision plots are completed for each pilot position for all their primary operations. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in flight that the external FOV allows the pilots to perform all their primary operations.
